text:
maria_support: FYI escalated from support inbox — user signed up via invite link, completed email verification, added GPay virtual card, but no welcome/free credit applied. Account: acct_0a9f, email user+eu@example.com, region: NL. Any quick checks? :thinking:

matt_eng: can you paste the signup time? I'll check autogrant logs. did they use a VPN? sometimes country IP mismatch triggers hold.

maria_support: signup timestamp 2026-02-18T12:34:22Z (unix 1708284862). No VPN reported. Customer said browser showed success and payment accepted.

oncall-bot: autogrant-service ERROR at 2026-02-18T12:34:23Z — grant failed account=acct_0a9f reason=pm_region_mismatch pm_country=US card_bin=552233xxxxxx user_region=NL

lei_billing: looks like PM country from BIN is US while user region is NL, so autogrant gated. We should verify bin normalization. Query:
```
SELECT id, pm_bin_country, autogrant_state FROM onboarding WHERE account_id='acct_0a9f';
```

matt_eng: thanks — if bin-country mismatch is the hit, policy was to manual-grant when user verifies email + KYC not required. @lei_billing can you confirm if this should've been autogranted?

lei_billing: policy: autogrant only when pm_bin_country == user_region OR pm_country_null. GPay virtual cards sometimes return US BIN even if billing in EU. We'll need manual override here. I'll add ticket to fix bin normalization rules.

sara_support: I can issue manual credit. What command? quick grant script? :pray: 

jordan_ops: run:
```
./tools/grant_bonus --account acct_0a9f --amount 50 --reason "manual_autogrant_vcard_usbin" --actor sara_support
```
Doing that now will reflect in Console under usage within ~2m.

maria_support: customer updated, please proceed. I'll notify them once granted.

jordan_ops: done — granted 50 credits, tx id tx_20260218_77. Confirmed autogrant flag set to "manual_override". Customer notified. :white_check_mark:

maria_support: closing loop — customer confirmed credits present and able to call API. filing followup to eng infra to look at bin-country heuristics. Thanks all! :tada:
